summary: Tested 3 improvements end-to-end: (A) Today's Coaching widget on /admin/dashboard, (B) Contact attachment retrofit to Emergent Object Storage, (C) Portal Support tab ticket pill + ThriveDesk copy cleanup. Full backend regression PASSED: 262/262 pytests in ~157s across all phases (ex-phase11/12/13/15/master per main agent's instructions). All 6 new pytests in test_coaching_and_attachments.py PASS. Frontend Playwright verified coaching card renders, refresh works, item click navigates to /admin/pipeline and auto-opens ProspectDrawer with ?focus= cleaned from URL; portal Support tab shows BL-2026-0019 ticket pill with click-to-copy and 'Slack + email' subtitle (ThriveDesk removed). No critical or minor backend/frontend issues.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — a11y warning only, drawer functions correctly. Consider adding aria-describedby to the Radix DialogContent for screen readers.

action_items: Optional polish: add aria-describedby to ProspectDrawer DialogContent to silence Radix a11y console warning (not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/pipeline/coaching/today correctly excludes won/lost, caps limit at 10, requires auth (401/403 without token), returns deterministic ranking (proposal $25k > new $0) — verified.

Contact attachment now writes to Emergent Object Storage with path prefix 'bybloomlabs/contact-attachments/...'; storage_path populated, legacy stored_path is None for new uploads. Public response correctly strips BOTH path fields — no internal leak.
Cross-client GET /api/clients/me/contact/attachment/{id} returns 404 (email-scoped filter hides existence — good security pattern, no auth leak).
Ticket pill rendered as monospace BL-YYYY-#### with proper data-testid 'contact-history-ticket-{id}'; navigator.clipboard.writeText verified working in browser context.
Subtitle copy updated correctly: 'Slack + ThriveDesk' -> 'Slack + email'. No stray 'ThriveDesk' string anywhere in /portal Support tab body.
PipelinePage useSearchParams ?focus={id} correctly auto-opens ProspectDrawer for the named prospect and removes the query param from URL after open — verified clean URL post-click.
Coaching card UI renders 2 items when only 2 active prospects exist (gracefully handles <3 case); refresh button hits the endpoint and re-renders without errors.

Backend regression suite 262/262 PASS confirms no regressions to contact_routes admin endpoints (POST /api/admin/portal-contacts and /resolve), project files, support triage, breezedocs, paypal, invoices, onboarding, phase16, phase18.5 etc.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows pass; 1 a11y console warning)
